mapper.sql: select a.user_id, coalesce(nullif(u.email, ''), a.email) email, u.nick_name, u.avatar, case when a.status = '1' or u.status = '1' then 'DISABLED' when a.paid_until is not null and a.paid_until > then 'PAID' when a.trial_end_time is not null and a.trial_end_time > then 'TRIAL' else 'DELAYED' end level, if(a.status = '1' or u.status = '1', '1', '0') status, a.register_time, a.trial_end_time, greatest(0, coalesce(timestampdiff(second, , a.trial_end_time), 0)) trial_remaining_seconds, a.trial_extend_hours, a.paid_until, a.last_access_time, a.register_ip, a.remark from option_member_access a inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) `total`, coalesce(sum(m.register_time >= date()), 0) `today`, coalesce(sum(m.level = 'TRIAL'), 0) `trial`, coalesce(sum(m.level = 'DELAYED'), 0) `delayed`, coalesce(sum(m.level = 'PAID'), 0) `paid`, coalesce(sum(m.level = 'DISABLED'), 0) `disabled` from () m

select date_format(a.register_time, '%Y-%m-%d') day, count(1) count from option_member_access a inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' where a.register_time >= #{since} group by date_format(a.register_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by day
select a.user_id from option_member_access a inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' where a.user_id in #{userId}
mapper.update: update option_member_access set trial_end_time = date_add(coalesce(trial_end_time, register_time), interval #{hours} hour), trial_end_time_utc = date_add(coalesce(trial_end_time_utc, register_time_utc), interval #{hours} hour), trial_extend_hours = trial_extend_hours + #{hours}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = , update_time_utc = utc_timestamp() where user_id in #{userId}

update option_member_access set paid_until = #{paidUntil}, paid_until_utc = date_sub(#{paidUntil}, interval 8 hour), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = , update_time_utc = utc_timestamp() where user_id = #{userId}
update option_member_access set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = , update_time_utc = utc_timestamp() where user_id = #{userId}
update option_member_access set last_access_time = where user_id = #{userId}
